summary: Elites actually arrive now: one wave in five after 8:00 carries a gold body
Elite variants: gold bodies with four times the hull, a large shard, and a chance of a heal
The window edge points at the danger you cannot see
The bomber: a blast whose circle you are shown while it lives
Enemies arrive as waves, bought with a spawn budget that grows with the run
The spitter: a telegraphed enemy shot
The darter: a telegraphed lunging enemy
The sky is a nebula: drifting clouds baked once, painted behind the stars
Wreckage and a wake: three particle shapes on the pool
The arena is a world: 3000x3000, a camera that follows and leans, energy walls at its edge
Hit-stop: the run holds its breath on a big kill and on a hit
Pre-rendered glow sprites: no blurs, no per-frame gradients
The dash: 220 px on rails, a 2.5 s wait, invulnerable through it
The ship flies like the plan says: acceleration, braking, a 6 px hitbox
Fixed-step simulation, seeded runs, collision grid and pools: the foundations release
First playable: the single-file neon arena survival baseline
